channels.name: Free door

revenue_classification.EXTERNAL_CUSTOMER: A settlement from a wallet not in X402_SELF_WALLETS or payTo, carrying a non-zero amount. Counts as revenue.
revenue_classification.INTERNAL_SELF_FUNDED: A settlement from X402_SELF_WALLETS or payTo. Infrastructure testing. NOT revenue.
revenue_classification.ZERO_VALUE_PROOF: A settlement carrying zero amount or no readable amount. Proves the rail. NOT revenue.
revenue_classification.UNKNOWN: A settlement whose payer or amount cannot be determined. NOT counted as revenue until classified.

current_state.classification: Rail proven. 1 external payer at 0.02 USDC. No repeat buyer. Shape/price iteration needed.
